usage: The word '好暗' is used to describe places or things that have little or no light.
It can refer to physical darkness or metaphorical gloominess but is most commonly used for physical spaces.
You can use '好暗' before a noun to describe the condition, like '房間好暗' (the room is very dark).
'好暗' can also be used alone as a short answer to say something is dark.
When comparing, you can say '呢度比嗰度好暗' to express 'this place is darker than that place.'
